purpose: Original atmospheric wallpaper; official Roselia logos and characters are separate source assets.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original atmospheric wallpaper for a personal BanG Dream! Roselia desktop application theme called Nocturne. Create a sophisticated 16:9 wide cinematic anime background painting, full bleed. An empty gothic concert hall stage at midnight, inspired by Roselia's elegant dark rock visual identity: ink navy, midnight indigo, restrained luminous violet, sapphire blue roses and silver filigree. Composition for a functional desktop UI: the LEFT 65 percent is very dark softly graded negative space, quiet with faint atmospheric light and minimal detail; the RIGHT quarter has a tall pointed gothic stained-glass arch/window with a pale moon beyond, delicate blue roses and black leaves growing up its lower edge, a few violet petals floating in soft stage light. At the lower-right corner one beautifully painted blue rose, tactile velvet petals, silver edge light. Elegant atmospheric perspective, refined Japanese animation background art, fine grain, sharp tasteful botanical details only at the periphery. Light beams subtle, not lasers. No people, no characters, no instruments, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no UI. Keep most of the canvas dark and quiet enough for text overlays; avoid busy repeating patterns and neon cyberpunk. Render landscape high resolution.
